question: It's recognized that Ferris returned to life via his own magic when he was in an explosion in arc three, but is that possible for other people as well? If there are conditions, please share those too!
answer: He has a self-repair spell at work on himself continuously, so his cells are continually rejuvenated, heightening their anti-aging and restoration power. Hence, Ferris is in a state of pseudo-immortality, and won't die so easily. No one else would be able to use it.
